name: Holiday Grinch-Fest at Tomoka Town Center
host: the Tomoka Town Center events page
paras: Tomoka Town Center in Daytona Beach hosts a Holiday Grinch-Fest on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 AM to 4 PM, and calls it a free family event.
Families can meet and take photos with the Grinch, and the center lists a special appearance by Santa.
Listed activities include games and prizes, a DJ playing holiday tunes, roaming holiday characters, specialty arts and crafts, face painting and balloon twisting.

Raffle prizes are drawn every 10 minutes from 11 AM to 4 PM, with a bonus prize drawing at noon and a grand prize drawing at 1 PM. Winners must be present, and the bonus drawing uses a free pre-registration form linked from the event page.
The center says weather may change or cancel the plans and points visitors to its social media for updates.

name: Christmas Celebration at Barnes and Noble Tomoka Town Center
host: the Barnes and Noble store events listing
venue: Barnes and Noble, Daytona Tomoka Town Center
address: 1115 Cornerstone Blvd Suite C, Daytona Beach, FL 32117
paras: The Barnes and Noble store at Tomoka Town Center lists a Christmas Celebration Event on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 2 to 5 PM.
The store invites families and friends to a day of Christmas activities: story time, letters to Santa, snowflake crafts, bingo, and cookies and hot cocoa.
For the letters to Santa, the store asks children to bring an envelope and a stamp.
The event is filed as an in-store special event, and the store phone number is (386) 281-4960.

name: Bingo with Buddy at GameTime
paras: ONE DAYTONA brings Bingo with Buddy inside GameTime on three evenings: December 1, 8 and 15, 2026, each from 6 to 8 PM.
Guests join Buddy the Elf for North Pole magic, holiday cheer and bingo, and the property says bingo is free to play.
GameTime offers dinner and drinks, bowling lanes and an arcade, so families can make a night of it, and ONE DAYTONA adds nightly fountain shows in Victory Circle.
ONE DAYTONA also runs a Wonderland holiday programming series across the property this season.

name: Rustic Christmas at the Lighthouse Children's Workshop
host: the Ponce Inlet Lighthouse events calendar
address: 4931 S. Peninsula Drive, Ponce Inlet, FL 32127
paras: The Ponce Inlet Lighthouse and Museum runs a children's workshop called Rustic Christmas at the Lighthouse in its Education Building.
The remaining December dates are Wednesday, December 2, Wednesday, December 9, Tuesday, December 15 and Thursday, December 17, 2026, with every workshop starting at 11 AM.
Tickets are sold through Lighthouse Locker, and space is limited to 15 participating children per date.
Admission is $11.95 for adults and $4.95 for participating children.
The lighthouse describes it as a hands-on holiday experience where children create something special for the season.

name: Presents in the Park Scavenger Hunt in New Smyrna Beach
host: the City of New Smyrna Beach event calendar
address: 1101 Live Oak St, New Smyrna Beach, FL 32168
paras: New Smyrna Beach Leisure Services hosts Presents in the Park, a scavenger hunt, on Friday, December 11, 2026 at 5 PM in the Live Oak Center park area.
The city's December calendar marks it as a free event with no set end time, under its Special Events category.
The same evening, the city shows The Polar Express as a free Movie in the Park at the Live Oak Cultural Center grassy area, with the movie beginning at dusk.

name: Southeast Volusia Holiday Boat Parade
address: Riverside Park, New Smyrna Beach, FL 32168
when_note: Saturday, December 12, at dusk (city calendar lists 6 PM)
paras: The Canal Street Historic District lists a Christmas Boat Parade on Saturday, December 12, 2026, on the Intracoastal Waterway at dusk.
The City of New Smyrna Beach calendar names it the Southeast Volusia Holiday Boat Parade and lists a 6 PM start.

The city calendar describes the route: it starts just south of Menard-May Park in Edgewater, travels north past Riverside Park in New Smyrna Beach, loops near the North Causeway, The Grille at Riverview and Bouchelle Island, and returns toward Riverside Park.
Watching from the shoreline along the route costs nothing.

name: Gingerbread Decorating Contest at First Church DeLand
host: the First Church DeLand digital bulletin
when_note: Sunday, December 13, 4 to 6 PM; register by December 6
paras: First Church DeLand holds its annual Gingerbread contest on Sunday, December 13, 2026, from 4 to 6 PM, and asks families to register by December 6.
The church provides the gingerbread houses and families bring their own decorations, with the rule that every element must be edible.
Dinner is provided, and the church's Outdoor Movie Night follows on the Pumpkin Patch from 6 to 8 PM.
The church office phone is 386-734-5113.

name: Outdoor Christmas Movie Night at First Church DeLand
host: the weekly First Church DeLand bulletin
paras: Bring a blanket or chair to the Pumpkin Patch at First Church DeLand for an outdoor movie evening on Sunday, December 13, 2026, scheduled for 6 to 8 PM.
The screening comes right after the church's annual Gingerbread contest, so some families arrive early for the 4 PM start of that contest.
The announcement appears in the church's weekly digital bulletin, and calls go to the church office at 386-734-5113.
